# Trainyard

> Open-source (Apache-2.0) planning rooms for scaled agile: PI planning boards, program board, ROAM, confidence vote, retrospectives and dashboards that sync two ways with Jira and Azure DevOps, every scaling model (SAFe Essential/Portfolio/Full, AI-Native SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, Nexus, Flight Levels, tribes) as editable configuration, an AI-native portfolio module with stage gates, EU AI Act risk tiers and an agent registry, and import of existing boards from Miro, Mural, monday.com, Trello, CSV and JSON.

Trainyard is self-hosted with Docker Compose and runs beside other sites on the same server behind Traefik. One edition includes every module. AI assistance works with Claude (Anthropic API key), any OpenAI-compatible server, or a local Ollama model; every AI answer is schema-validated and is a draft a person accepts.

## What it does

- PI planning: built-in boards sized to the workspace's teams and iterations; drag cards between iterations, draw dependencies, vote confidence, ROAM risks, run Inspect & Adapt.
- Tracker sync: features, stories, risks and dependencies pulled from Jira and Azure DevOps; moves on the board pushed back through an inspectable queue; webhooks and scheduled sync.
- Operating models: work levels, cadences, events, roles and metrics are data; fork a template and rename things to match your organisation.
- Lean portfolio: epics with WSJF, budgets and guardrails, OKRs.
- AI portfolio: initiatives and platforms with lifecycle stages, gates with evidence and evaluations, EU AI Act risk tiers, agents with autonomy levels 0 to 4, value-architect sign-off, audit log.
- Reporting: metric catalogue (flow, planning, portfolio, AI) and dashboards you compose; AI-written narrative on request.
- Bring your own boards: Miro REST v2, Mural, monday.com GraphQL, Trello, CSV, JSON; boards kept as imported, saved as templates, mapped onto the plan on demand.
- Security: API keys hashed at rest, roles (admin, planner, architect, viewer), rate limits, sign-in lockout, strict Content Security Policy, encrypted connection tokens, append-only audit.

## Pages

- Landing: /
- Sign in: /login (API key issued by an admin)
- App (needs a key): /dashboards, /board, /portfolio, /templates, /imports, /ai, /agents, /model, /sync, /users

## Source and docs

- Code and README: https://github.com/mlbwhf/test/tree/claude/confident-cray-JTbgD/trainyard
- API reference: the API serves OpenAPI at /docs on its own host (api.agileagilist.com)

## Comparable products

iObeya, Miro (PI planning templates), Jira Align, Planview, Targetprocess. Trainyard differs in being open source, self-hosted, model-agnostic for scaling frameworks, and in including an AI-native portfolio module.
